description: EventSubscriptionDestination, DeadLetterDestination, and AdvancedFilter are polymorphic (on endpointType / operatorType); the converted model keeps only the discriminator, so S.Struct strips the subtype payload (destination `properties`, filter `value`/`values`) on encode and decode. Add them as untyped documents.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Endpoint-type-specific destination properties (polymorphic on `endpointType`), e.g. `{ resourceId, queueName }` for StorageQueue.
Endpoint-type-specific dead-letter properties (polymorphic on `endpointType`), e.g. `{ resourceId, blobContainerName }` for StorageBlob.
Single comparison value for NumberGreaterThan/NumberLessThan/BoolEquals-style operators (polymorphic on `operatorType`).
